newsitem.title: USA: Sprint, Viacom in Blockbuster Internet deal.
newsitem.headline: Sprint, Viacom in Blockbuster Internet deal.

text.p: Sprint Corp and Viacom Inc later on Thursday are to announce a joint promotion of Sprint Internet access products at Viacom's Blockbuster video stores.

Industry sources said the deal was the first major initiative from an alliance between the two companies announced in October and will include free software and direct entry into a Blockbuster home page with music and video clips.
"It is the first entertainment oriented versus information oriented Internet service we have seen and could bode well for the companies," said an industry source who declined to be identified.

The companies said in October that the agreement allows for Sprint to develop and distribute Internet access products with Viacom's various business units, including Blockbuster Entertainment Group and Simon & Schuster.
